title: Ruleswright Snapshot Envelopes — snapshotVersion 1
description: Three serializers (FR-14): character, party, combat. State only — no timestamps, no captured environment. Every envelope carries pack identity; combat pairs with a party snapshot. Load discipline: identity check first; mismatch = loud refusal E-SNAP-01; stale version = E-SNAP-02. No v1 migration.

contentHash.description: Pack content hash; mismatch on load = E-SNAP-01 (FR-14)

rngState.description: Four uint32 sfc32 words (FR-1). Resume test: next roll equals the uninterrupted fight's next roll.

xp.description: XP accumulates per class per pack split policy (FR-6)

items.description: Binding: null = empty slot, string = memorized spell id (FR-8)

slot.description: A slot id declared in the pack's equipSlots

itemId.description: A content.items id whose slots list admits this slot

equipped.description: v1.4 — optional equipment state: one {slot, itemId} entry per occupied slot (one item per slot). Absent = nothing equipped (equivalent to []). The runtime emits the key only when the character's state carries it, preserving the byte-exact round-trip of characters that never equipped. Slot uniqueness across entries cannot be expressed in JSON Schema (uniqueItems compares whole objects), so runtime restore enforces it fail-closed, together with item/slot existence, slot eligibility and held quantity — any violation = E-SNAP-01, all refusals collected before any application. Inventory still restores verbatim.

hp.description: v1.12 / AR-02: optional for legacy input; new writers emit exact current and temp. No clamp, including negative current or above-derived-max. Absence uses legacy reserveValue reconstruction and temp=0. Temp remains bookkeeping; old readers cannot preserve this guarantee.

pairsWith.description: Party snapshot id — the documented pairing (FR-14)

hp.description: v1.11 — current hit points, no lower bound. Damage is not floored: hp <= 0 means down (no turns, no trigger offers, never blocks movement; the end rule). Written as-is; restored as-is. The heal cap is maxHp.

slotsUsed.description: Per-turn transient: generic slot economy state (FR-4)

position.description: Present only when the pack declares a spatial model (FR-11)

pendingTrigger.description: Reactive action currently offered (FR-4/13). v1.6: legacy — read on restore when offers is absent; v1.6 writers no longer emit it.

itemsUsed.description: v1.4 — optional: item id -> units this combatant has SPENT in this fight (not units remaining). Deliberately unlike slotsUsed, which serializes the remaining per-turn ledger: fight-start item balances are not in the snapshot — restore takes them from the host's re-stated CombatRestoreRequest balances (balances.items), the same way pools and boundSlots are re-stated (since v1.6 their spend is recorded too, in poolsSpent and slotsCast), and this snapshot value wins for the spend. Remaining = restated balance - itemsUsed. An unknown item id or a spend exceeding the restated balance = E-SNAP-01. Absent = nothing spent.

maxHp.description: v1.4 — optional: the combatant's heal cap, fixed at fight start (characters: derived hp with equipment grants; statblocks: the hp formula value). A heal never raises hp above maxHp and never lowers hp: a combatant already above its cap stays unchanged. Restore precedence: this snapshot value wins over the re-stated profile; when absent (a pre-v1.4 envelope) restore falls back to the profile's maxHp, then to the profile's hp (floored at 0).

offeredDepartures.description: v1.12 / AR-05: new paused-move writers always include this array. Complete tuples already offered, including events with offers still queued. Resume only after the queue is answered; suppress exact from/to/reactorId tuples, check new edges/reactors; discard at move end. Containing actor and reactor must exist on opposing sides, coordinates integer, no duplicate tuples (runtime validates identities). Legacy absence preserves first-step suppression; do not infer a complete history from an empty queue.

pendingMove.description: v1.5 — optional: a move paused by open leaving-reach offers (FR-11). Resumes when the offer queue empties. Unknown or non-move actionId = E-SNAP-01. Absent = no paused move. Restore phase: the envelope phase when present (v1.6); otherwise the v1.5 derivation, resolved when any combatant carries pendingMove or pendingTrigger.

poolsSpent.description: v1.6 — optional: pool id -> points this combatant has SPENT in this fight (the itemsUsed precedent). Restore: pool = re-stated balances.pools - poolsSpent. Unknown pool or over-spend = E-SNAP-01. Absent = nothing spent.

slotsCast.description: v1.6 — optional: spell level -> indices of the fight-start bindings consumed in this fight (by a spell, the lowest uncast index bound to it; by a vancian action, the lowest uncast non-null index, or the lowest uncast index below boundSlots for a count-only combatant). Restore: boundSlots = re-stated count - indices; an index out of range, on a null binding, or for a level with no re-stated slots = E-SNAP-01. Absent = nothing cast.

phase.description: v1.6 — optional: the fight's phase when frozen. Restore: frozen hp satisfying the end rule -> combat-over; else this value; else the v1.5 derivation. combat-over while no side is defeated = E-SNAP-01.

offeredCount.description: v1.6 — optional: offers raised so far; the next trigger:fired.offerIndex continues from it. Absent = 0.

on.description: The live event type that raised the offer

offers.description: v1.6 — optional: every open trigger offer, in queue order. v1.6 writers emit this (when non-empty) instead of the per-combatant pendingTrigger. Present together with any pendingTrigger = E-SNAP-01. An unknown actor, or an id that is not a reactive action/feat that actor holds = E-SNAP-01.
